subject: Film & Cinema
title: Shot Sizes: From Wide to Close-Up
description: A quick, practical guide to Shot Sizes: From Wide to Close-Up.

hook.text: A wide shot makes you feel small. A close-up puts you inside someone's soul.

buildup.text: Shot sizes range from extreme wide to extreme close-up, each creating a different feeling.

discovery.text: Wide shots establish context. Medium shots show interaction. Close-ups reveal emotion.

twist.text: Overusing close-ups cheapens them. The most powerful close-up is the one you've waited for.

climax.text: Every great director instinctively knows which shot size the story demands at each moment.

punchline.text: The size of the shot tells the size of the feeling.

quiz.question: What does a close-up shot primarily reveal?
options: A character's emotion and inner state
